stem:
What is the relationship between the thousands place and the tens place in the number shown?

583,436

options.label: A
options.text: The thousands place is two times greater than the tens place.

options.label: B
options.text: The thousands place is ten times greater than the tens place.

options.label: C
options.text: The thousands place is one hundred times greater than the tens place.

options.label: D
options.text: The thousands place is three hundred times greater than the tens place.

difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding place values and comparing magnitude between thousands and tens places, involves reasoning with multiplication factors.
